summary: Copies pit-stop part state from a source vehicle state (a2) into a destination pit-stop state struct (this): bulk part data blocks, tire brand lookup, compound index search over the valid-part list, scoring interval computation (fixed 1024/2048/3072 slots, or CRTFtol-based cumulative distances when the scoring scale is non-zero), session-dependent compound override, and finally the pit-stop callback chains. Returns the result of PitstopStateTransition on the first callback list.

local_names.this: destination pit-stop state struct being populated
local_names.v7: search index into the valid-part list
local_names.v8: compound index of the source vehicle's current part

operations.description: Bulk-copy part state from the source into this: qmemcpy 0x40 bytes from a2+3248 to this+88; clear byte this+117 (field 0x75); copy a2+6340 into this+108 (field 0x6C); qmemcpy 0x40 bytes from a2+4720 to this+216; copy this+236 into this+240 (fields 0xEC/0xF0); clear byte this+245 (field 0xF5).

Resolve the tire brand with TireBrandLookup(a2+112) and store it in this+344 (field 0x158). If the previous this+348 value (field 0x15C) is negative and the session type (dword_7C56A4) is 5..7, check the compound at CompoundIndexLookup(a2+3012): if its byte at +20 is clear, override this+348 with a2+3012.

Search the valid-part list: call FindZeroResultIndex(this), read the part count at this+168 (field 0xA8), then scan v7 from 0 while v7 < count looking for NthValidPartLookup(v7) == CompoundIndexLookup(a2+3012). Write v7 to this+172 (field 0xAC); if no match was found (v7 reached count), set this+172 to 1.

Advance the pit-stop state machinery with ArithmeticComparison_5660(0) and StateTransition(0), then copy the scoring base a2+6276 into this+352 (field 0x160) and the scoring scale double a2+6548 into this+380 (field 0x17C) as a float.

Compute the three scoring intervals. When the scale a2+6548 is 0.0: write fixed (start, value) pairs (1024, a2+6340), (2048, a2+6404), (3072, a2+6468) into this+356/360, this+364/368, this+372/376 (fields 0x164/0x168, 0x16C/0x170, 0x174/0x178). Otherwise compute cumulative CRTFtol distances: ((double)(a2+3268) * (double)(a2+3256) + (double)(a2+3248)) * a2+6548, then the next two from the a2+6320/6328/6340 and a2+6384/6392/6404 triples, each minus dword_7D0374; store the running totals and the source values (a2+6340/6404/6468) into the same six slots.

Run the callback chains: zero this+388/392/396 (fields 0x184/0x188/0x18C), then if *(this+12) (field 0xC) is non-null invoke FlagBasedLoopConditionalCall on it, and likewise for *(this+16) (field 0x10). Return PitstopStateTransition(*(this+12)).
